description:
This screenshot displays the 'General Information' section within the 'Edit Extraction' view of the CLC+ (CORINE Land Cover Plus) Core user interface. It presents various fields for defining metadata for a data extraction. Required fields are marked with an asterisk (*).

The form fields and their pre-filled or suggested values are:
-   **Name***: ES616_roads
-   **Country***: ES Spain/España (with an option to clear)
-   **Region**: ES616 Jaén (with an option to clear)
-   **Reference Year***: (empty input field with a calendar icon)
-   **Time Range of Extracted Data***: (empty input field with a calendar icon), accompanied by the descriptive text "The time range of when the data was produced."
-   **INSPIRE Themes***: (empty input field), with a hyperlink to "INSPIRE theme register" providing "An overview of all themes and their details". This refers to Directive 2007/2/EC.
-   **Resolution**: 10 m
-   **Created By**: CLC+ Core User Admin/Support (hyperlinked)
-   **Organisation/s***: Displayed as two pre-selected tags: "CLC" (CORINE Land Cover) and "European Environment Agency".

Two action buttons are visible in the top right: "CANCEL" and a green "SAVE" button.
